title.source: Zippo終身免費修，2次送修留下什麼？｜品牌故事
title.text: Zippo: free repairs for life—what did 2 shipments leave?｜Brand Story

description.source:
同一句終身功能承諾，怎麼落在不同的舊物上？從2022美國收藏者Joseph遲遲未寄的鬆蓋舊物，追同包兩只修件。1933首款/保證只歸屬公司後來回憶。帶環Camden款補繩、看來換pin且無新焊痕；同包普通款換hinge。其後是2024日本ゆきいるか粉紅禮物不能點火、寄修後新舊內膽同返。兩次送修、不同人國家與物件，沒有同serial延續、互相啟發或修法移用。47日只日本單次旅程，不是實修工時或現行時限。JP未公開完成表/勾選/退舊要求或原因、未記回件後成功燃燒；US不補原先不能點火或廠內新焊接工序。UK2026退舊條件只按地域短說；US當代finish exclusion不擴成全球所有產品。

description.text:
How does the same lifetime functional promise apply to different old belongings? In 2022, US collector Joseph hesitated to send an old lighter with a loose lid, then mailed two together. Zippo’s first 1933 model and guarantee are attributed only to the company’s later recollection. The looped Camden model gained a lanyard, apparently a replacement pin, and no new weld marks; the ordinary model in the parcel received a hinge. In 2024, Japanese author Yukiiruka’s pink gift could not ignite; both old and new inserts came back after repair. These are two shipments involving different people, countries and objects, with no shared serial continuity, mutual inspiration or transfer of repair methods. The 47 days describe only that Japanese round trip, not repair labor or a current deadline. The Japanese author published no completed form, checked box, request for the old insert or explanation of its return, and recorded no successful burning afterward. The US case does not establish an original ignition failure or new factory welding. UK 2026 old-part-return conditions apply only to that region; the current US finish exclusion is not a claim about all products worldwide.

c20r3o01: 面對開頭那個鬆蓋，喬瑟夫早就想試試免費修，
但這個念頭，擱了將近一年。
c20r3o02: 這句能用、否則免費修的承諾，
公司後來回顧一九三三年首款時，也把它寫進去。
c20r3o13: 他甚至怕，有一部分可能會掉走；
這是他對繼續使用的顧慮，不是已經弄丟。
c20r3o15: 他在回顧裡說，自己曾看過一些修過的舊件，
鉸鏈歪斜，旁邊留著不好看的痕跡。
c20r3o17: 當他把一批待修舊物的照片，放進社群想找人交換時，
有人問他，為什麼不寄回去？
c20r3o18: 這個提醒，卻沒有先替他回答，
這種帶環的鉸鏈，現在還能不能照原樣處理。
c20r3o19: 他先寄了一封電子郵件，問的就是，
這只特殊款還能不能恢復原來的樣子。
c20r3o20: 你若要把有刻字的舊物交出去，大概也會想，
先得到一個說得夠具體的答覆。
c20r3i03: 在送修表上，他要求修好鉸鏈和小環；
如果可以，也補上已經缺掉的繫繩。
c20r3i04: 他當時讀到的說明，按產品有不同的包裝和寄法，
自己只關心口袋打火機。
c20r3i08: 我覺得抉擇就在那個「如果可以」：繫繩，
是他提出的希望，還不是已經拿到的結果。
c20r3i13: 他說，三月第一週，自己仔細做好保護，
再照這份表格裡的地址，把包裹送走。
c20r3e08: 喬瑟夫說，這只換上的鉸鏈，接點看起來，
像他近期見過的新打火機一樣整齊。
c20r3e10: 你若以為免費修，就是把它的外觀全部變新，
這次的回件，給的是另一種結果。
c20r3e15: 只是其中一只還有他不想失去的顏色，
這也正是寄出時，他仔細包裝的原因。
c20r3e16: 我覺得這個擔心很實在：修好連接處，
還不等於替他決定，怎麼保護表面。
c20r3e19: 這只帶環舊物修理的，是連著盒蓋的結構；
而負責點火的內膽，還有另一層。
c20r3e20: 傳統款把內膽抽出時，上蓋與鉸鏈仍跟著外殼，
點火機件則留在抽出的內套裡。
c20r3t01: 兩年後在日本，開頭預告的那只粉紅小盒，
因內部機件問題，進了寄修包裹。
c20r3t02: 這是收到的禮物，他估計已用約三到四年，
期間曾換火石，也換過裡面的填料。
c20r3t16: 他把外殼與內膽分開包好，放在同一個袋子，
讓這份禮物的兩部分，一起離開手邊。
c20r3n01: 開頭那個粉紅小盒的回件拆開後，
他寫下的結果是，新舊兩組內膽都在裡面。
c20r3n05: 作者還寫，寄去的東西全回來了，圖說列出緩衝材、
紙膠帶，郵件袋也跟著回到手邊。
c20r3n09: 他沒有公開填妥的表格，也沒有交代退舊的理由，
不能替他補上一個申請。
c20r3n11: 英國二〇二六年版修理表，寫的是內膽通常換新；
想拿回舊的，得在說明欄要求。
c20r3n12: 這份英國的條件，讓你看到，想修好與想拿回原件，
可以是兩個要說清楚的要求。
c20r3n16: 回到開頭，Zippo承諾的是恢復工作；
要留下哪些舊東西，還有使用者自己那一份選擇。

lines.source: 你若像這位收藏者，一次寄修兩只舊物，想留的痕跡，會被免費修掉嗎？
lines.text: If you sent two old lighters for repair like this collector, could a free repair erase the marks you wanted to keep?

lines.source: 二〇二二年，美國，收藏者喬瑟夫準備寄出一只舊 Zippo。
lines.text: In 2022, in the United States, a collector named Joseph was preparing to send off an old Zippo.

lines.source: 盒蓋晃得厲害，鉸鏈旁邊，還有一個原本能接繫繩的小環。
lines.text: The lid wobbled badly, and beside the hinge was a little loop that had originally held a lanyard.

lines.source: 他想修緊那裡，卻又怕，外殼添上難看的修補痕跡。
lines.text: He wanted that connection tightened, but feared ugly repair marks on the case.

lines.source: 等回件到了，小環旁邊，會不會多出新的焊痕？
lines.text: When it came back, would there be fresh weld marks beside the loop?

lines.source: 兩年後，日本另一只粉紅小盒寄出，原來的內膽，還會回來嗎？
lines.text: Two years later, another little pink lighter was mailed from Japan. Would its original insert come home too?

lines.source: 今天沿著 Zippo 兩次真實送修，看終身承諾怎麼處理新機件與舊物。
lines.text: Today, we follow two real Zippo repair shipments to see how a lifetime promise handles new mechanisms and old belongings.

lines.source: 我想問的是，它到底保證修好什麼，又替你留下什麼？
lines.text: What I want to ask is: what exactly does it promise to fix, and what does it leave you with?

lines.source: 面對開頭那個鬆蓋，喬瑟夫早就想試試免費修，但這個念頭，擱了將近一年。
lines.text: Joseph had long wanted to try a free repair for that loose lid from the opening, but put the idea aside for almost a year.

lines.source: 這句能用、否則免費修的承諾，公司後來回顧一九三三年首款時，也把它寫進去。
lines.text: In its later account of its first lighter in 1933, the company also included that promise: it works, or it is repaired free.

lines.source: 落到他手上，問題變成：把這只舊盒送走，換回來的，會是什麼樣子？
lines.text: For him, the question became: if he sent this old lighter away, what would it look like when it returned?

lines.source: 我在意的，是那個「修」字，最後會落在哪一個零件上。
lines.text: What interests me is which part that word “repair” would ultimately apply to.

lines.source: 你若想把某些舊東西留下，免費二字，還沒有替你選完。
lines.text: If you want to keep certain old parts, the word “free” has not made every choice for you.

lines.source: 那位美國收藏者標到的舊盒，究竟還留下哪些特徵？
lines.text: What features remained on the old lighter that this American collector had won at auction?

lines.source: 他說，這是一次深夜或清早，在拍賣網站標到的舊物。
lines.text: He said he had bought it on an auction site late one night or early one morning.

lines.source: 整只已經磨損，盒上還有船隻與盾牌圖樣，也留著刻字。
lines.text: It was worn all over, with ship and shield designs on the case, as well as an inscription.

lines.source: 那些圖案還保有不少顏色，讓這只舊殼，不只是任意一個金屬盒。
lines.text: Those designs still held quite a bit of color, making this old case more than just any metal box.

lines.source: 帶著這樣的小環與鬆蓋，這只舊物，還適合直接帶在身上用嗎？
lines.text: With that little loop and loose lid, was this old lighter still suitable to carry and use as it was?

lines.source: 開頭那個亂晃的蓋子，讓他擔心，繼續照原本用途帶著走，反而會更傷。
lines.text: The wobbling lid from the opening made him worry that carrying it for its original purpose would cause more damage.

lines.source: 他甚至怕，有一部分可能會掉走；這是他對繼續使用的顧慮，不是已經弄丟。
lines.text: He even feared a part might fall off. That was his concern about continued use, not something he had already lost.

lines.source: 但知道廠商說免費修，他就立刻寄回去了嗎？
lines.text: But once he knew the maker offered free repairs, did he immediately send it back?

lines.source: 他在回顧裡說，自己曾看過一些修過的舊件，鉸鏈歪斜，旁邊留著不好看的痕跡。
lines.text: In his account, he said he had seen some repaired old lighters with crooked hinges and ugly marks beside them.

lines.source: 當他把一批待修舊物的照片，放進社群想找人交換時，有人問他，為什麼不寄回去？
lines.text: When he posted photos of a batch of old lighters needing repair in a group, hoping to trade, someone asked why he did not send them back.

lines.source: 這個提醒，卻沒有先替他回答，這種帶環的鉸鏈，現在還能不能照原樣處理。
lines.text: That suggestion did not answer whether a hinge with this loop could still be restored to its original form.

lines.source: 他先寄了一封電子郵件，問的就是，這只特殊款還能不能恢復原來的樣子。
lines.text: First, he sent an email asking whether this special model could be restored to the way it had been.

lines.source: 你若要把有刻字的舊物交出去，大概也會想，先得到一個說得夠具體的答覆。
lines.text: If you were handing over an old engraved belonging, you would probably want a sufficiently specific answer first too.

lines.source: 那麼，這封信寄出後，他真的等到完整回覆，才把打火機裝箱嗎？
lines.text: So after sending that email, did he really wait for a full answer before packing the lighters?

lines.source: 他等得不耐，最後沒有繼續等回信，就決定把打火機寄出去。
lines.text: He grew impatient and finally decided to mail the lighters without waiting any longer for a reply.

lines.source: 真正交給修理端時，他有沒有把要求寫得更具體？
lines.text: When he actually handed them over for repair, did he make his requests more specific?

lines.source: 在送修表上，他要求修好鉸鏈和小環；如果可以，也補上已經缺掉的繫繩。
lines.text: On the repair form, he asked them to fix the hinge and little loop and, if possible, replace the missing lanyard too.

lines.source: 他當時讀到的說明，按產品有不同的包裝和寄法，自己只關心口袋打火機。
lines.text: The instructions he read then gave different packaging and mailing methods for different products. His concern was only pocket lighters.

lines.source: 開頭同包的另一只普通鍍鉻款，他要求接回上蓋，並裝上一組新的內膽。
lines.text: For the other, ordinary chrome lighter in the same parcel mentioned at the start, he requested reattachment of the lid and a new insert.

lines.source: 這只普通款，他連怎麼取得都記不清，只記得，來自一小批舊物。
lines.text: He could not even clearly remember how he had acquired that ordinary model, only that it came from a small lot of old items.

lines.source: 他不指望那只舊款靠外表吸引人，卻說，很希望它能繼續派上用場。
lines.text: He did not expect that old model to attract anyone with its looks, but said he very much wanted it to remain useful.

lines.source: 剛剛那只帶環的舊盒，在他公開的照片裡，對應的修理表勾的是哪一欄？
lines.text: For the old lighter with the loop, which box was checked on its repair form in his published photograph?

lines.source: 你能看見，後方那張表的鉸鏈插銷欄，打了一個勾。
lines.text: You can see a check in the hinge-pin box on the form at the back.

lines.source: 我覺得抉擇就在那個「如果可以」：繫繩，是他提出的希望，還不是已經拿到的結果。
lines.text: To me, the choice lies in that “if possible”: the lanyard was something he hoped for, not a result already in hand.

lines.source: 那包舊物，是隨便丟進信封，就直接寄出嗎？
lines.text: Did he just toss those old lighters into an envelope and mail them?

lines.source: 他當時讀到的表格，建議用堅固的盒子，或有緩衝的郵寄袋。
lines.text: The form he read at the time recommended a sturdy box or a padded mailer.

lines.source: 表格還提醒，多件寄修，難以追蹤或避免損傷，建議一包放一到兩只。
lines.text: It also warned that multiple repair items were difficult to track or protect from damage, and recommended one or two per parcel.

lines.source: 他說，三月第一週，自己仔細做好保護，再照這份表格裡的地址，把包裹送走。
lines.text: He said that in the first week of March, he carefully protected them and sent the parcel to the address on that form.

lines.source: 表格地址和一些收藏者記得的不一樣，這次包裹，到底到了沒有？
lines.text: The address differed from the one some collectors remembered. Had this parcel actually arrived?

lines.source: 三月十八日，一封電子郵件，帶來了收件消息。
lines.text: On March 18, an email brought confirmation of receipt.

lines.source: 他在日記裡記下，通知收到了兩只，數量跟自己同一包寄出的相符。
lines.text: He recorded in his diary that the notice listed two lighters received, matching the number he had sent in that one parcel.

lines.source: 他原本沒有預期，廠商還會主動寄來，收件與出件的通知。
lines.text: He had not expected the company to send receipt and dispatch notifications on its own initiative.

lines.source: 收到之後，那封原本詢問特殊鉸鏈的信，就有答案了嗎？
lines.text: After they received it, had his original email about the special hinge been answered?

lines.source: 還沒有；他先等到的是三月二十九日，另一封通知，說包裹已經寄回。
lines.text: Not yet. First came another notice on March 29 saying the parcel had been sent back.

lines.source: 一直到這份出件通知之後，他才收到先前那封詢問的回覆。
lines.text: Only after that dispatch notice did he receive a reply to his earlier inquiry.

lines.source: 但那封信，只是一般性地表示能修，沒有特別回答帶環鉸鏈該怎麼處理。
lines.text: But that email merely said in general terms that repairs were possible. It did not specifically answer how the looped hinge would be handled.

lines.source: 我這時會更想打開包裹，直接看看，這次他到底拿回了什麼。
lines.text: At this point, I would want even more to open the parcel and see exactly what he had got back.

lines.source: 你若是他，這時最想確認的，應該也是那個自己特別提出過要求的小環。
lines.text: If you were in his place, you would probably also most want to check the little loop you had specifically asked about.

lines.source: 那只他原本怕添上焊痕的舊殼，最後真的多了一道傷嗎？
lines.text: Did the old case he feared would gain weld marks actually come back with a new scar?

lines.source: 開頭那個小環旁邊，喬瑟夫回件後看，沒有看到新的焊痕或疤。
lines.text: After its return, Joseph looked beside the little loop from the opening and saw no new weld marks or scars.

lines.source: 他說，缺掉的繫繩補上了，原本鬆動的鉸鏈，也收緊了。
lines.text: He said the missing lanyard had been replaced and the loose hinge tightened.

lines.source: 小環是怎麼留下來的？他的觀察是，看來只換了那根彎成環的插銷。
lines.text: How had the loop been preserved? His observation was that only the pin bent into a loop appeared to have been replaced.

lines.source: 他用的是「看來」，這是拆包後的觀察，不是廠內逐步怎麼修的紀錄。
lines.text: He said “appeared”: an observation after unpacking, not a step-by-step record of the factory repair.

lines.source: 同包裡那只要接回上蓋的普通舊款，回來時，又有什麼不同？
lines.text: And what was different when the ordinary old model in the same parcel, whose lid needed reattaching, came back?

lines.source: 喬瑟夫說，這只換上的鉸鏈，接點看起來，像他近期見過的新打火機一樣整齊。
lines.text: Joseph said the joints on this replacement hinge looked as neat as those on new lighters he had seen recently.

lines.source: 而這只外殼上，原先的表面磨損，也跟著回來了。
lines.text: The original surface wear on this case had come back with it too.

lines.source: 你若以為免費修，就是把它的外觀全部變新，這次的回件，給的是另一種結果。
lines.text: If you thought a free repair meant making the entire exterior look new, this return showed a different outcome.

lines.source: 不過包裹裡的擺法，反而讓他又擔心起，殼上留下的顏色。
lines.text: But the way the parcel was packed made him worry again about the color remaining on the cases.

lines.source: 他覺得，兩只舊物像是直接放進氣泡信封，回程時可能互相碰撞。
lines.text: He felt the two old lighters seemed to have been placed straight into a bubble mailer and might have knocked against each other on the return trip.

lines.source: 這次真的撞壞，或掉了他想留的漆嗎？
lines.text: Had they actually been damaged this time, or lost paint he wanted to preserve?

lines.source: 他隨即補充，這次送達完好，並不是在抱怨已經發生的損傷。
lines.text: He immediately added that they had arrived safely. He was not complaining about damage that had occurred.

lines.source: 只是其中一只還有他不想失去的顏色，這也正是寄出時，他仔細包裝的原因。
lines.text: One of them simply still had color he did not want to lose, which was also why he had packed them carefully before sending them.

lines.source: 我覺得這個擔心很實在：修好連接處，還不等於替他決定，怎麼保護表面。
lines.text: I find that concern very practical: fixing a connection does not also decide how he wants the surface protected.

lines.source: 他要怎麼避免，下次再讓兩只舊物，在回程碰在一起？
lines.text: How would he avoid two old lighters knocking together on the return journey next time?

lines.source: 他說，未來一次只寄一只，讓舊塗裝少一點互相碰撞的機會。
lines.text: He said he would send only one at a time in future, reducing the chance of old finishes rubbing against each other.

lines.source: 這只帶環舊物修理的，是連著盒蓋的結構；而負責點火的內膽，還有另一層。
lines.text: On this old lighter with the loop, the repair concerned the structure connecting the lid. The insert responsible for ignition is another layer.

lines.source: 傳統款把內膽抽出時，上蓋與鉸鏈仍跟著外殼，點火機件則留在抽出的內套裡。
lines.text: On a traditional model, when you pull out the insert, the lid and hinge stay with the outer case, while the ignition mechanism remains in the removable inner unit.

lines.source: 同一個「修」字，可以落在外殼的連接，也可以碰到內部整組機件。
lines.text: The same word, “repair,” can apply to the case connection or involve the entire internal mechanism.

lines.source: 但如果壞的是內膽，廠商會修原來那組，還是乾脆換一組新的？
lines.text: But if the insert is broken, will the company repair the original one or simply replace the whole unit?

lines.source: 兩年後在日本，開頭預告的那只粉紅小盒，因內部機件問題，進了寄修包裹。
lines.text: Two years later in Japan, the little pink lighter previewed at the start went into a repair parcel because of an internal mechanism problem.

lines.source: 這是收到的禮物，他估計已用約三到四年，期間曾換火石，也換過裡面的填料。
lines.text: It was a gift. Its owner estimated having used it for around three to four years, replacing the flint and the packing material inside during that time.

lines.source: 開合太鬆之後，他在裡面，看見了什麼問題？
lines.text: After the opening and closing became too loose, what problem did the owner find inside?

lines.source: 他看到凸輪彈簧裂了，也說曾用產品結構圖，查故障部位的名字。
lines.text: The owner saw a cracked cam spring and said a product diagram had helped identify the faulty part by name.

lines.source: 他說，也許因此，磨輪也轉不動了，已經沒辦法點火。
lines.text: The owner said this might also explain why the flint wheel would no longer turn and the lighter could no longer ignite.

lines.source: 這一次，使用者會直接寄回廠商，還是先找零件，想辦法自己修？
lines.text: This time, would the user send it straight to the maker or first seek parts and try repairing it at home?

lines.source: 他先往網路找，覺得零件若能備齊，在家修，也許不是完全辦不到。
lines.text: The owner first searched online, thinking a home repair might not be entirely impossible if all the parts could be found.

lines.source: 但因為自己這只不是一般大小，替換零件的搜尋，最後看來走不通。
lines.text: But because this lighter was not the usual size, the search for replacement parts ultimately seemed to lead nowhere.

lines.source: 廠商那裡，還有能接手的入口嗎？
lines.text: Was there still a route to have the maker take over?

lines.source: 他當時也沒有原盒與收據，查維修費時，想過若太貴，就乾脆買新。
lines.text: The owner no longer had the original box or receipt and, while checking repair costs, considered buying a new lighter if repairs were too expensive.

lines.source: 他查到正品有免費終身保證；我這才看到，選擇裡多了送回廠商這條路。
lines.text: Then came the discovery of the free lifetime guarantee for genuine products. That is where I see returning it to the maker become another option.

lines.source: 查到保證後，他選的，仍是把這份禮物寄出去，沒有就此換掉整只。
lines.text: After finding the guarantee, the owner still chose to send this gift away, rather than replace the entire lighter.

lines.source: 他當時交出去的，會只有那個小零件嗎？
lines.text: Was that little part the only thing handed over at the time?

lines.source: 他在備忘錄列的送修內容，是外殼、內膽與修理表。
lines.text: The owner's memo listed the case, insert and repair form as the contents sent for repair.

lines.source: 他把外殼與內膽分開包好，放在同一個袋子，讓這份禮物的兩部分，一起離開手邊。
lines.text: The case and insert were wrapped separately and placed in the same bag, so both parts of this gift left together.

lines.source: 你若想留下用慣的機件，這時要等的，還不只是粉紅外殼能不能回來。
lines.text: If you wanted to keep the mechanism you were used to, you would now be waiting for more than just the pink case to return.

lines.source: 整趟往返四十七天後，他收到寄回的包裹。
lines.text: After a full round trip of 47 days, the owner received the parcel back.

lines.source: 他以為廠商既然整組換新，卸下來的舊內膽，應該就不會再寄回。
lines.text: The owner had assumed that if the company replaced the entire unit, the old insert it removed would not be sent back.

lines.source: 那開頭預告的粉紅小盒回來時，包裹裡，真的少了原來那組嗎？
lines.text: So when the little pink lighter previewed at the start came home, was its original insert really missing from the parcel?

lines.source: 開頭那個粉紅小盒的回件拆開後，他寫下的結果是，新舊兩組內膽都在裡面。
lines.text: After opening the returned parcel with that pink lighter from the opening, the author wrote that both the new and old inserts were inside.

lines.source: 作者照片的左邊，是打開的粉紅殼，裡面裝著一組內膽。
lines.text: On the left of the author's photograph is the open pink case with an insert fitted inside.

lines.source: 右邊還有另一組，表面磨損比較明顯，放在氣泡材料上。
lines.text: On the right is another insert, with more visible surface wear, resting on bubble wrap.

lines.source: 跟著內膽返還的，只有這些金屬嗎？
lines.text: Were those metal pieces the only things returned with the inserts?

lines.source: 作者還寫，寄去的東西全回來了，圖說列出緩衝材、紙膠帶，郵件袋也跟著回到手邊。
lines.text: The author also wrote that everything sent had come back. The caption lists cushioning material and paper tape, and the mailing bag came back too.

lines.source: 我會把旁邊那組收好，因為換下來的，也可能正是你想留下的東西。
lines.text: I would put that other insert away carefully, because the part replaced might be exactly what you want to keep.

lines.source: 這回原內膽一起回來，是不是因為他事先在送修表上，特別要求了？
lines.text: Had the original insert come back this time because the owner had specifically requested it on the repair form beforehand?

lines.source: 他沒有公開填妥的表格，也沒有交代退舊的理由，不能替他補上一個申請。
lines.text: The author did not publish the completed form or explain why the old insert was returned. We cannot invent a request on the author's behalf.

lines.source: 那今天想把舊內膽拿回來，還能只靠這次個案的結果，不另外問嗎？
lines.text: So if you want an old insert back today, can you rely on this one outcome without asking separately?

lines.source: 英國二〇二六年版修理表，寫的是內膽通常換新；想拿回舊的，得在說明欄要求。
lines.text: The UK repair form dated 2026 says inserts are normally replaced; to get the old one back, you must request it in the instructions field.

lines.source: 這份英國的條件，讓你看到，想修好與想拿回原件，可以是兩個要說清楚的要求。
lines.text: That UK condition shows you how getting something repaired and getting the original part back can be two requests that need spelling out.

lines.source: 美國現在的條款，還承諾連塗裝與裝飾，都一起翻新嗎？
lines.text: Do the current US terms also promise to renew the finish and decoration?

lines.source: 美國明列，塗裝與裝飾不在終身保證內；功能修好，並不承諾外觀翻新。
lines.text: The US terms explicitly exclude finishes and decoration from the lifetime guarantee. Restoring function does not promise an exterior makeover.

lines.source: 這位日本作者也沒有記錄回件後的燃燒表現，照片裡沒有火焰。
lines.text: This Japanese author also did not record how the lighter burned after its return, and there is no flame in the photograph.

lines.source: 回到開頭，Zippo承諾的是恢復工作；要留下哪些舊東西，還有使用者自己那一份選擇。
lines.text: Back to the opening: Zippo promises to restore function. Which old pieces to keep also involves a choice for the user.

lines.source: 如果是你的舊物，你會特別要求留下哪一部分，還是只想讓它繼續陪你？
lines.text: If it were your old belonging, which part would you specifically ask to keep, or would you simply want it to stay by your side?

lines.source: 想繼續看日用品一句承諾，怎麼變成具體的選擇，歡迎訂閱品牌故事。
lines.text: To keep seeing how a promise about an everyday object becomes a concrete choice, subscribe to Brand Story.
